parameters: If only you knew how mistaken you are, Zanatus...\| But you will know soon enough.

Much has changed since last we did battle, Donar.\! Before the first war, humanity was united in banner and in faith.\! Now, your people are born lost and without purpose.\! Although this has made you easy to manipulate, it tempts me to put your species out of its misery, and render your kind extinct forever.
Watch out, he's winding up to swipe us with those claws... don't stand in their path!

It is quite the gambit, coming here, to the Divine Realm, the bridge between what you know to be your home, and the endless darkness beyond this fragile barrier.\! I would admire such boldness if from anyone else!
Damn, nothing can get through that shield.\! Stop those reinforcements from overwhelming us, and avoid those hot spots - he's targeting them with his magic!
Everyone, we need to destroy those soldiers quickly.\! He's trying to absorb them and gain more power!

Do you know how much I pity your kind, \n[8]?\! I have watched your supposed greatest minds try to make sense of your history.\! I have seen your institutions lie to your great masses, under the guise of maintaining peace and control.\! Despite this, how little control has your kind ever had.\! Your fates are pre-determined, and history will see me as the great truthteller - the one who saved humanity from its own hubris!
Yes. You have done enormous damage to our kind.\! It will take many generations to repair.\! Perhaps, it never will happen after so many centuries of spilling our own blood - wasted blood.

But now, we know how to recapture our destiny. All we needed was to see and know the enemy... and it is within us.\! You and your cult have poisoned and manipulated us, but you overestimate your power.\! When you are dead, more just like you will continue to weave chaos, but our fate will once again be ours to decide.\! ...Do you feel that, Zanatus?\! I know you can.\! Surely you feel how my heart is at peace.\! Even if I die today, I've fulfilled my purpose - I've awoked my kind to who you are, and I will rest in peace knowing your grip on humanity is broken, forever.

\n[8]...\|\| I imagine you foresaw this.\! In the end, I have served my purpose.\! And to a far, far greater power, I will be of use.\! And then, the races of this little realm will understand the meaning of humility...
